description: Deterministic code quality analysis for .NET, built on Roslyn. Write rules in a LINQ-like DSL, store them as .ccr files, and analyze a solution or project from the command line with CI-friendly exit codes. Restores versioned rule profiles from the CodeCharter portal, runs rule specs, gates line coverage, and ships an MCP server so AI coding tools can analyze on demand. Documentation: https://codecharter.tools. Requires a valid CodeCharter license or API key at runtime.
